title: Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 – Countries
transformations: Select the 31 countries in countries.json; preserve their source island components.
Unwrap and split polygons at the antimeridian; normalize longitudes to [-180,180].
Keep full country latitude extent; polar clipping is applied only when calculating TAC intersections.
resolutionNote: Natural Earth is a generalized cartographic dataset; islands omitted at 1:50m cannot be inferred from this source.
